mechanism.base: Water is what metal becomes when it stops holding its shape. In the old texts the cold blade gathers dew out of the morning air, and metal melted in enough heat runs like a river. So the child of steel is the stream. What the edge kept hard and silent, the water carries off and says. A spring under a mountain is the ore learning to move.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Water, this channel shows as pressure without release: much forged, little said. That is why your chart asks you to feed it. Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.

function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is what pours out of you and feeds someone. The wish to feed has you giving comfort and telling the story, never being fed. The wish to shine has you saying the line too good to keep, but you pay in the people it lands on.
function.advise_catalyst: Ease is a gift right up until it dodges every hard thing. Pick one piece of what you make and finish it all the way, past pleasant. Say the awkward true sentence once a week, to the person it belongs to. Send one thing out before it feels ready.

candidates.cta_verdict: What you say or make comes out finished, and it gets quoted back to you later more often than you expect, whether you meant it to travel or not.
